transcript.text: Which tier is the house tier? Answer with the tier name.

args.sql:
SELECT c.tier, COUNT(*) as order_count
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.tier
ORDER BY order_count DESC

transcript.text:
The "house tier" is defined as the customer tier with the most orders. Query results show basic tier has the highest order count (552), well above plus (361) and enterprise (287).

FINAL ANSWER: basic
